title: The Next Chapter of Africa-China Climate Cooperation
gist: Development Reimagined's tracker records 246 China-Africa climate actions across 50 African countries from 2022 to H1 2026, including nearly 49 GW of renewables in the pipeline; the author says the partnership has evolved beyond these headline metrics. Short excerpt.

insights.claim: Development Reimagined's China-Africa Climate Action Tracker captures 246 publicly announced climate actions across 50 African countries between 2022 and the first half of 2026, including nearly 49 GW of renewable energy in the pipeline, clean technologies, clean transport and, more recently, critical minerals.
insights.speaker: Yike Fu
insights.so_what: Sizing of the Chinese clean-energy build-out pipeline in Africa; critical minerals is the newer theme.

insights.claim: The author argues that counting projects, investment size and renewable commitments captures only part of a China-Africa climate partnership that has evolved significantly since the 2021 FOCAC 8 declaration.
insights.speaker: Yike Fu
insights.so_what: Look beyond announcement counts to implementation quality.
